On the job: alignment, pattern and protection.
The care behind
the finish.

Chris is a time-served domestic decorator, with over 45 years of experience described on his Which? profile. Established in 1986, the business focuses on reliable, respectful work and customer satisfaction.

Protect and prepare
Surroundings protected and surfaces thoroughly prepared, using specialist preparation materials.
A considered approach
Water-based paints and a sanding system described on Chris's profile as 95% dust-free.
A conversation, every day
Daily updates, so you know what work is planned.

Full public liability insurance is listed on the business profile.

“Careful and considerate at all times.”
